World of Warcraft: Forever
Carve a New Path in An Azeroth Reimagined

Azeroth—an untamed frontier begging to be explored. Answer its call when World of Warcraft: Forever launches on November 4, 2026. Quest through the original world of Azeroth enhanced with new and expanded zones.
Upgrade to the Skyborne Epic Pack to unlock the new Skyborne race along with their Zephras Isle starting experience, Beta access, Early Name Reservation for your first adventures, in-game cosmetics, and more!
